title: 第14章 晋升真元境
slug: 修罗武帝全本免费-修罗武帝最新章节列表
content_zh:
在这里，姜辰不运转炼魂诀，炼魂诀也在自动运转。
而且，速度也更快了。
不过，前进了大概十米左右之后，姜辰就走不下去了。
一种无法形容的感觉生出，就好像是吃东西吃撑了一样。
姜辰毫不怀疑，他继续走下去的话，灵魂会撑爆，爆炸。
姜辰心中凛然，心念一动，立刻转身。
转身后，这撑爆的感觉立刻消失。
姜辰没有迟疑，退出了黑山的入口，当下，眼前的世界陡然一亮，光芒甚至于似乎有些刺眼。
姜辰回到了魂海虚空。
深吸一口气，姜辰离开了黑山的范围，在虚空盘坐，开始修炼起武道功法来。
这次，之前那种即将突破的感觉消失了，身体似乎因为灵魂的蜕变而更加的凝实和厚重。
姜辰修炼了将近两个时辰，那种武道境界圆满的感觉再次生出。
随后，姜辰退出了魂海虚空，在外界苏醒了过来。
在魂海虚空内，姜辰时时刻刻，也是可以感受到外界的身体的情况的。只不过他在魂海修炼的话，灵魂进入魂海空间，肉身便像是处于一种无法无念的状态一样。若是不修炼的话，肉身便像是死了一样，没有丝毫生机气息呈现。
如今，姜辰苏醒，便将姜韵给他的三枚紫气丹拿了出来，然后毫不犹豫的放入口中。
随后，姜辰牢记各种药性气息之后，便凝神屏息，开始炼化丹药。
灵魂之力呈现，体内的紫气立刻疯狂运转了起来。
吞入腹中的三枚紫气丹，已经化作了浩荡的紫气，汹涌而来，十分强大。
这样的紫气丹，一枚是温顺的，但是三枚一起吃，一般人一定会被撑死，毕竟是三倍的能量。
可是这强大的能量在出现之后，直接被姜辰的任督二脉陡然一吸，能量就去了一半。

能量还来不及被灵魂能量压制，姜辰的三道武脉顿时又是一吸，另外一半的紫气，就这样的光了。
姜辰没任何感觉，反而觉得，丹药的数量，远远不够用。
姜辰有点儿傻眼，不过他也只是遗憾了片刻，便释然了。
随后，姜辰进入魂海空间，开始吸纳天地元气修炼。
有了紫气丹的能量，再加上姜辰自我感悟修炼，在魂海空间的近乎百倍修炼速度的加持下，姜辰体内的先天紫气，开始剧烈的液化。
而且，这种过程非常迅速。
从开始液化，到全部化作真元力，也不过区区一刻钟而已。
一般的修士，这种蜕变的过程，需要足足三天左右的时间。
而姜辰，一刻钟，不仅蜕变了真元，便是三大武脉和周身奇经八脉、正十二经和任督二脉等经脉，也都全部的再次被扩大了许多。
姜辰的境界，也毫无阻碍的踏入了真元境。
踏入真元境之后，姜辰立刻有一种入道的感觉，就仿佛，天地间的力量，自己已经可以借用。
这是一个全新的领域，刚刚踏入这个境界，姜辰立刻有着深深的体悟。
他立刻便明悟到，这或许才是武道的真正门槛。
不到真元，不入武道！
这种说法，果然没错！
后天，先天，哪怕是战力再强，都是自身的力量，而真元开始，修炼之法，就隐含了天地之间的力量，蕴含着天地的至道规则，蕴含着法则的力量！
“这真是一个令人迷恋的修炼世界啊！”
姜辰感叹，随即他的手朝着虚空一拍。
“嗡——”
玉质古剑立刻飞舞了出来。

姜辰不再手持古剑，却轻易操控。
强大的灵魂力，让姜辰有一种人剑合一的莫名感觉。
那种对于古剑的恐惧和忌惮之意，也已经完全的消失不存了。
似乎，里面的可怕恶魔，也不值得姜辰忌惮了。
姜辰没有以灵魂的力量去感应这柄剑，这柄剑，如今他只是当作一件普通的兵器，而这件普通的兵器，也已经远比一般的兵器强大，这就已经足够了！
姜辰踏入真元境之时，姜韵却已经教导完姜家弟子的修炼了。
她从天剑宗回来，一来是宗门的假期，另外一方面，也是姜家发展壮大的一个原因，就是宗门的弟子一旦有些成就，有空闲的时候，就应该回家族教导末学后进之辈。
当初，是其余的师兄们教导她，如今她踏入了真元境四重大圆满，有空闲自然应该回来教导族人。
宗门的修炼之法不能外传，这是有着严格的要求的，但每个家族之中，也有着自己的底蕴。

content_en:
Here, Jiang Chen is not running the Soul Refining Technique, but the Soul Refining Technique is also running automatically.
Moreover, the speed is also faster.
However, after advancing about ten meters, Jiang Chen couldn't walk any further.
An indescribable feeling arose, as if I had eaten too much.
Jiang Chen had no doubt that if he continued walking, his soul would burst and explode.
Jiang Chen felt awe-inspiring in his heart, and immediately turned around with a thought in his mind.
After turning around, the overwhelming feeling disappeared immediately.
Jiang Chen did not hesitate and exited the entrance of Black Mountain. At that moment, the world in front of him suddenly lit up, and the light even seemed a bit dazzling.
Jiang Chen returned to the void of the soul sea.
Taking a deep breath, Jiang Chen left the range of Black Mountain, sat cross-legged in the void, and began to practice martial arts.
This time, the previous feeling of impending breakthrough disappeared, and the body seemed to become more solid and thick due to the transformation of the soul.
Jiang Chen practiced for nearly two hours, and the feeling of perfect martial arts realm came back again.
Later, Jiang Chen exited the void of the soul sea and woke up in the outside world.
In the void of the soul sea, Jiang Chen could feel the physical conditions of the outside world all the time. But if he practices in the Soul Sea, his soul will enter the Soul Sea space, and his physical body will seem to be in a state of helplessness and thoughtlessness. If you don't practice, your physical body will be dead, without any vitality.
Now that Jiang Chen woke up, he took out the three purple energy pills Jiang Yun gave him and put them into his mouth without hesitation.
Later, after Jiang Chen memorized the scents of various medicinal properties, he concentrated and held his breath and began to refine the elixir.
The power of the soul appeared, and the purple energy in the body immediately began to circulate crazily.
The three Purple Qi Pills swallowed into his belly have turned into a mighty purple Qi, surging forward and becoming very powerful.
One such Purple Qi Pill is docile, but if you eat three of them together, most people will definitely be strangled to death. After all, they have three times the energy.
However, after this powerful energy appeared, it was directly sucked in by Jiang Chen's Rendu Second Meridian, and half of the energy was lost.
Before the energy could be suppressed by the soul energy, Jiang Chen's three martial arteries were suddenly sucked in again, and the other half of the purple energy was just like this.
Jiang Chen didn't feel anything. Instead, he felt that the quantity of pills was far from enough.
Jiang Chen was a little dumbfounded, but he only regretted it for a moment and then felt relieved.
Afterwards, Jiang Chen entered the soul sea space and began to absorb the vitality of heaven and earth to practice.
With the energy of the Purple Qi Pill, coupled with Jiang Chen's self-understanding and cultivation, and the blessing of nearly a hundred times the speed of cultivation in the Soul Sea Space, the innate purple Qi in Jiang Chen's body began to violently liquefy.
Moreover, this process is very rapid.
From the time it started to liquefy to when all of it turned into true energy, it only took a mere quarter of an hour.
For an average monk, this transformation process takes about three days.
And Jiang Chen, in a quarter of an hour, not only transformed his true energy, but also the three major martial arteries and the eight extraordinary meridians, the twelve main meridians, and the second Rendu meridians all over his body were all greatly expanded again.
Jiang Chen's realm also entered the true essence realm without any hindrance.
After entering the True Yuan Realm, Jiang Chen immediately felt like he had entered the Tao, as if he could already borrow the power between heaven and earth.
This is a brand new field. Just stepping into this realm, Jiang Chen immediately had a deep understanding.
He immediately realized that this might be the true threshold of martial arts.
If you don’t have true energy, you won’t be able to enter the martial arts!
This statement is indeed correct!
Acquired, innate, no matter how strong the combat power is, it is all one's own strength, and starting from the true essence, the method of cultivation implies the power between heaven and earth, contains the ultimate rules of heaven and earth, and contains the power of law!
"This is such a fascinating world of cultivation!"
Jiang Chen sighed, and then clapped his hand towards the void.
"Buzz——"
The ancient jade sword flew out immediately.
Jiang Chen no longer holds handsHe holds an ancient sword but is easy to control.
The powerful soul power gave Jiang Chen an inexplicable feeling of man and sword becoming one.
The fear and apprehension of the ancient sword had completely disappeared.
It seemed that the terrifying demon inside was no longer worth Jiang Chen's fear.
Jiang Chen did not use the power of his soul to sense this sword. Now he just regards this sword as an ordinary weapon, and this ordinary weapon is already far more powerful than ordinary weapons. This is enough!
When Jiang Chen stepped into the True Yuan Realm, Jiang Yun had already finished teaching the disciples of the Jiang family how to practice.
When she came back from Tianjian Sect, it was a holiday for the sect. On the other hand, it was also one of the reasons for the Jiang family's development and growth. Once the disciples of the sect achieved some success and had free time, they should return to the family to teach the underachievers.
In the beginning, it was the other senior brothers who taught her, but now that she has reached the fourth level of perfection in the True Element Realm, she should naturally come back to teach her tribe when she has free time.
The sect's cultivation method cannot be passed on to others. This has strict requirements, but each family also has its own heritage.
